scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web "npm run dev --workspace shared" "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json
